gold_own_risk: High, about 30% within 12 months (vs 4% band rate); agrees with model direction but says score understates risk
candidate_own_risk: High, roughly 30%; partly agrees with model, direction right but 0.5-0.7 band (4%) understates risk

key_points.point: Verdict: real risk, own risk high ~30% vs 4% band; agrees with model direction but score understates the risk
Liabilities 158% of assets and current ratio 0.43, worst among SIC-30 peers; equity about -$429.8m; all ~$710m debt reclassified as current
Missed/past-due interest and lender defaults; company says it lacks resources to repay if debt is accelerated
Going concern doubt from auditor, 10-K 7 months late, 2023 10-Qs unfiled, NYSE notices, explicit bankruptcy warning
Net loss of -$232.5m is mostly a non-cash deferred tax write-off; underlying continuing-ops cash earnings $68m (vs $193m in 2021), so loss overstates damage but cash earnings still fell ~65%
Almost no liquidity: $16.3m unused credit lines vs $56.8m of 2023 cash interest (2.4x 2022 operating income); supplier pressure on payment terms
Sales still falling in 2023: Q1 down 17-19%, Q2 guided to $260-270m (-21% to -24%)
Evidence against: lender restructuring waived defaults, extended ~$348m to 2027 with PIK, cut amortization; nothing large due before July 2025; deadlines extended by lenders and NYSE
Operating cash flow -$34.0m (near worst among peers), FCF -$65.8m, cash $110.1m lasts ~20 months (or ~9 at Q1-2022 burn), Q4 2022 positive, 97% of cash abroad
One-off cash inflows (Indonesian property sales, Brazil deposit refund, Indonesian tax refunds, Hemingway plant sale) and covenant tests from ~March 2024 where a breach is expected

contradictions: Candidate places operating cash flow at the 29th peer percentile and net income at the 12th, while GOLD says both are near the worst (only 1 of 23 peers lower on each).

Candidate estimates cash would last about 36 months at the current burn (using $102.9M September 2022 cash), while GOLD estimates about 20 months using $110.1m year-end cash and free cash flow of -$65.8m (or ~9 months at the Q1-2022 rate).
Candidate's revenue peer percentile (86) and current assets percentile (67) do not match GOLD's peer ranks (11 of 21 and 12 of 24 peers lower, i.e. near the median).
extra_points_in_candidate: Restructured debt is costly: SOFR + 6.00% and 14.00% PIK.
July 2023 interest payment forecast at risk due to insufficient liquidity (8-K 2023-07-07).
Limited Revolver access of up to $21.0 million restored after the restructuring.
Weekly $15M minimum U.S. liquidity test and 13-week cash forecasts as near-term tripwires.
Q1 2022 $75.0M buyback funded by the revolver; $880.0M Credit Agreement of November 2021.
Nuvo asset sale mentioned among asset sales.
summary: CANDIDATE matches GOLD on the verdict (real risk, high ~30%, model understates) and covers the core distress evidence: the underwater balance sheet, missed interest, defaults, going concern doubt and the lender restructuring. It misses the continuing ~20% sales decline in 2023, only partly covers the thin liquidity versus cash interest and the underlying cash earnings, and gives peer ranks and a cash runway that differ from GOLD's.
